attempts.rationale: The findings list Patient, QuestionnaireResponse, and multiple anamnese-* Observation extensions as unmapped targets. This StructureMap has only one group (Transform-bodyheight) targeting a single bodyheight Observation resource with no groups or rules for Patient, QuestionnaireResponse, or other resources. Adding rules to `/group/0/rule/3/rule/-` can only add sibling rules under map-component for additional component fields within this single Observation - it cannot create the necessary new resource types (Patient, QuestionnaireResponse) or their corresponding rule groups that these findings require. The 35+ unmapped source-to-target routes span multiple FHIR resources beyond what a single-group StructureMap can express.
